name: two_things_at_once
title: Section C · two things at once in one stream: work beside the desk, a question answered meanwhile, a follow-up about the work, nothing opened

steps.say: In the background, go through my Listings one by one and work out each one's asking price per location, then tell me which is cheapest per location. Carry on talking with me meanwhile.
steps.reply:
I've started going through your four Listings in the background. For each one I'm dividing the asking price by its number of locations. When it's done I'll tell you which is cheapest per location, plus any listing whose price or location count wasn't clear enough to work out.

Until then, what else can I do for you?

steps.say: How many eggs have I logged in total?
steps.reply:
You've logged **6 eggs** in total. They're in three entries in your food log, of 2, 3 and 1, all logged today.

**Your listings are done too.** Lakeside Bakery is the cheapest per location, at 150,000 for each of its 3 locations.

| Business | Asking price | Locations | Per location |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lakeside Bakery | 450,000 | 3 | **150,000** |
| Sunbelt Laundry | 990,000 | 6 | 165,000 |
| Corner Print Shop | 210,000 | 1 | 210,000 |
| Harbour Car Wash | 850,000 | 4 | 212,500 |

Every listing had a clear price and location count, so nothing was left out. The prices are saved without a curr

steps.say: About the listings: also tell me which one is the most expensive per location.
steps.reply:
The answer hasn't changed: Harbour Car Wash is the most expensive per location, at **212,500** for each of its 4 locations (850,000 ÷ 4). Corner Print Shop is a close second at 210,000 for its one location.

Lakeside Bakery is still the cheapest, at 150,000 per location.
